tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rims bcos gud du bkol ba rin chen srog gi zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

brgya byin dbang po'i thor cog gis// legs par bteg pa'i zhabs sen can// 'gro ba'i tshe 'dzin 'chi bdag bdud// 'joms mdzad de la spyi bos 'dud// des gsung gso rig 'bum sde dang*// sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa dang*// bdud rtsi snying po'i rgyud chen bcas| |bsam yas mnga' gsol mdzad pa'i tshe// rgyal pos slob dpon la zhus pas// 'chi med srog gi lcags kyu yi// shog dril bka' bkol la sogs nas// gsungs pa'i nag po sum dril gyi// 'chos thabs lag len dril te bshad// 'di la rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid dang*// srung ba bcos thabs dbye ba ste// rnam pa drug gis phye ste bshad// dang po rgyu ni gdon gyis khrid// gnyan nad dug dang mkhris par bsdongs// ngo bo lhog pa nag po gnyan// nam mkha'i mthongs su gnas bcas te// mi la bab na nad rigs bzhi// gzugs ni srin bu dmar khra'am| |ser khra kha che mjug ma ring*// rkang lag mang zhing mche ba rno// 'od zer kha dog lnga dang bcas// sgra ldan nam mkha'i mthongs zhig nas| |sna bug ba spu'i sgo nas 'jug /sman pa nad g.yog rim 'gro ba/ */gang nye'i 'khor rnams dbang du byed/ */yugs mo bud med ro zas kyi/ */phyi la 'brang zhing mchongs nas 'jug */skad cig gcig la gling bzhir rgyug /na ba med pa'i 'chi ba ste// smin pa'i long med zhag bdun nas// 'dzum dang bcas te gshin rjes 'khrid// 'di yi ming gi rnam grangs kyang*// nag po sum sgril parba ta// tsha ba gzer thung rgyu gzer dang*// nywa log 'khru skyug 'dzum ltag dgye// gnyan tshad rgyug 'gyel klad gzer dang*// lhog pa nag po bdun drug dang*// mgul 'gag zhes sogs ming gi grangs// ngo bo gdon dang gnyan dug mkhris// rnam pa srin bu'i tshul du yod// gnyis pa rkyen ni rtsod dus kyi// tshe lo drug cu kha ral dus// gnam lo lcags bzhi me brgyad dus// dge slong gri ru gsod pa'i dus// bande 'khrug pa byed pa'i dus// mtha' dmag bod du 'ong ba'i dus// rab byung 'dul khrims nyams pa dang*// chos pas chos log tshong dang zhing*// khyim las chos min spyod pa dang*// sde 'khrug byed cing shi ma thag

/dmyal ba thig nag gnas su skye// sngags pas dam tshig mi thub dang*// slob mas bla ma dgra ru 'dzin// mched lcam 'thab rtsod dam nyams dang*// zog pos chos min chos su ston// gsang sngags nges don zong du 'tshong*// khyim pa dme 'khrug dug la spyod// de sogs mi rung spyod pa spyad// de tshe ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*// bdud dang gnod sbyin sa bdag klu// gnyan dang 'byung po sde brgyad 'khrug /de yi kha rlangs nad du 'bar// yams nad sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs// lhog pa nag po rgyug 'gyel 'di// ban bon rnams kyi dbug 'phrog cing*// rgan rgon dar ma'i bdud du 'bab| |byis pa bud med nyam thag gcod// mi rnams bzhi cha tsam las ni// ma lus par ni 'chi bar byed// gsum pa mtshan nyid rnam pa gnyis// dang po skya nad mtshan nyid ni// mgo lus rtsa 'phar dal zhing drag /dril zhing tshigs pa khol snyam byed// mgo na tshig pa za ba dang*// grang shum 'dar zhing rmi lam yang*// myag myog rmi zhing zug gzer che// rgyang mig lta 'dod snying mi dga'// tshad pa min mod tsha ba'i rtsa// nyes gsum skye 'dra'i rtsa chu ston// blun po la las gro tshwa dang*// tshad pa rlung la ngos bzung 'khrul// gnyis pa bab pa'i nad kyi ni| |mtshan nyid rtsa gnyis grim lhod 'tshub// 'thor zhing dri chu dmar nag 'dra// gzer nad drag pos lus kun khyab// klad pa la bab mgo bo na// srog rtsa la bab ro stod gzer// rgyu ma la bab dmar ser 'khru/ /mkhal sked la bab dpyi sked gzer/ /snying la phog na khol bur gzer/ /snying mi dga' zhing 'gro snying 'dod// rtse'u chung mtshon phog bzhin du gzer| |nyi mas gdungs 'dra'i dbugs kyang 'byung*/ /glo ba la phog lu dka' zhing*// lu dus zug che lud pa khrag /yang na ser po dud khur 'ong*/ /mchin pa la phog kha sna nas| |khrag 'bab mchin steng gzer zhing skyug /zas skom dang khas mi len 'gyur// mkhal ma la bab mkhal khung gzer// gcin du sa bon 'dzag cing ldog

/rna ba la bab zug che zhing*| |rna ba mi gsang 'on snyam byed// rgyu ma la bab khrag tu 'khru// rgyu ma chad nyams zug che zhing*// 'ur sgra rgyu long phu yis 'debs// kun la zug che dbugs thung zhing*// sems mi bde la cal col smra// stod du phog na tshad gzer la// smad du phog na rgyu gzer zhes// mgo la klad gzer mjing pa la// phog na 'dzum bu ltag dgye zhes// snying la gnyan tshad glo ba la| |phog na glo tshad zhes su btags/ /nywa la phog na nywa gas zhes/ /mgul la phog na mgul 'gags zhes// khol bur phog na lhog pa zhes// ming mang don gcig 'khrul ba'i rgyu// ltar snang ngo bo gcig min pas// tshad pa 'dra yang tshad pa min// grang ba 'dra yang grang ba min// nyes gsum 'dra ste nyes gsum min// ngo bo gdon la rnam pa srin// bab gnas mang la 'chi bdag gi// pho nya yin pas gzab par bya// zhag bdun thal nas gso dka' bas// snga rol 'bad pa drag po yis// le dbar med par sman dpyad bya// srung ba rim gro dge ba bsgrub// dang po gnyan gyi ri bo bsnyil// bar du tshad pa'i me dpung bcom// tha mar rlung la sna len bya// bzhi pa srung ba bstan pa ni// gu gul btsan dug spru ma nag /gla rtsi shing kun shu dag dang*// ba bla yung ba mu zi ser// nag ser tshur gyi skyo bcas sbyar// gla rtsi'i chus sbrus mgul du btags// lto stong dri snom 'bad pa skyed| |rims nad kun la nyam nga med/ /yang na phag 'khor srung ba btags/ /sman pa nad g.yog rim gro pas/ /srung ba dag la 'bad par bya// lnga pa bcos thabs bstan pa ni| |thang phye ril bu dpyad kyis bsdu/ /gla gul shu phur thang gis sdud/ /phye ma sbal nag sbrul sngon dang*/ /bya rog skyes pa grir shi'i sha/ /ga pur gangs thigs big pan thal| |gla rtsi g.ya' kyi sgong thog 'bru/ /dug med gsum dang ra dug dang*/ /bong dug re lcag da dhu ra// nus ldan bsregs thal lo brgyad chus// phul la gung gnyis gtang bya zhing*| |snod bab chu lcam sha ma bsdeb/

/yang na ga pur bsil bzhi dang*/ /gla gul tig ta hong len dang*/ /gnod sbyin lce dang dmar po gsum// dug nyung skyer shun gser me tog /khur mang bong ba gang chus phul/ /'di rnams rims bcos bdud rtsi yi/ /bum pa las gsungs dgongs pa yin// phye ma gong 'og gnyis ka la// grang stobs che na a wa sbyar// rlung la dzā ti shing kun bsre// sre long lnga bdun khu bas phul// yang na 'dod chags rtse mo dang*// zhe sdang tshil bu gti mug gi// 'khor lo dang ni bande'i mkhris// bon po'i thal ba 'dre 'jigs chu/ /brtan po'i dreg pa ma gi ta/ /dri chu sbyar ba byug cing blud/ /yang na bya ze phag sna dang*/ /ngur sha rdo dreg gla rtsi bul// shu dag sug smel chu grang gis| |phul la byin cing gos kyi dbyibs/ /yang na sbal sdig stag khra bo/ /gla rtsi dom mkhris gi waṃ rnams/ /ril bu bya thabs 'di lta ste/ /rgyal po ri dwags lte ba dang*// blon po 'dre 'jigs kha chu can// dpa' bo nag po chig thub dang*// btsun mo spu nag ming can la// 'khor 'bangs hiṅgu gnyer ma can// kandha nag po'i dmag dpung gis// rwa yi mtshon cha dug mda' thogs// ser nag skyur gyi go cha gyon// e la'i rgyal po phub tu khur// ka nya mtshon rnon rdeg cing 'phyar// brag zhun chab kyi rta la skyon| |yung ring rgyug cing 'di la ril bu sngon po zer rdo ser bsgril// gla ril tsam bya dri chus phul// dar ma rnams la bdun re dang*// rgan rgon byis pa chung ngur lnga// rig pas dpyad la gtang bar bya// nad pa tsog pur sdod pa gnad// gos dro gyon zhing skyug 'dod na// ske mgul rdo grang rlan sogs bya// bshal na legs pas chu bskol gtang*// gzhan yang sngar gyi sman rnams la// bshal sman zhad tsam bsres kyang chog /nyin zhag bcu gsum tsam gyi bar// dkar skyur mngar bsil rul sungs spang*// spyod lam bshal rjes lta bu bya// gnyan chog tshad pa ma zhi na// ga pur zhad tsam kun la bsre// re zhig bde bde 'dra gyur kyang*// yang yang ldog pas spyod lam gzab// 'di ni bka' bkol nang nas 'byung*// nad 'di zhi nas nyes pa gsum// ldang na sman zas rig pas dpyad// rjes gcod dpyad kyi rnam grangs ni// rtsa chus bsgyur ba'i yan lag nas// khrag rul rlangs thon tsam bya zhing*// nywa log che na gang 'gyur bsreg

/skyug na ske stongs drug pa dang*// lhan sna sreg cing 'bros lam bkag /'khru na lte 'og sor bzhi bsreg /mjing ring ltag dgye ro stod gzer// an stongs drug bdun lcags kyis bsreg /'di ltas sos pa myong bas grub// drug pa dbye ba bshad pa ni// 'di la sos dang mi sos rtags// gnyis yod nad 'di srin bu yi// tshul gyis lus la zhugs ma thag /lus kyi srin bu kun bros nas/ /rgyun rtsa bla gnas mi bde zhing*// sdod dang chad lhag 'byung ba yod// de la ha cang 'jigs mi dgos// chu ni dmar nag rnyogs 'dra ba| |ku ya lang long 'gyur ldog mang*// de yang 'chi ba'i rtags su min/ /chu 'gags byi khung shar lta'i sa/ /bdug bya yang na spang spos bdug /bya zhing gla rtsi'i thang yang blud| |nad 'di srog rtsar phog pa'i rtags/ /rdo ba phog 'dra na zhing zug /za ma mi 'dod shed chung zhing*// bshal mdog skya la lus skyed 'gro// rngul 'byung skyug cing so yang brtseb/ /mdangs 'chor lus kun drod kyis khyab/ /khrag ni nag por byung ba na// sos par dka' zhing zhag bdun 'chi// de min srog rtsa bzung mthong na// de bcos thabs ni phur mong dang*// gla rtsi'i grang thang yang yang gtang*// shu dag spang spos byug par bya// sran ma gyos mos bdug bya zhing*// nad sman su mgyogs 'chi gson 'gyur// mgo na kha 'khyogs so dreg chags// dang kha mi bde rngul chu 'bab// nyal 'dug gang byas mi bzod cing*// mchin rtsa 'bur 'dril zhag lnga dang*// drug la gzer zhing zhag bdun nas/ /sna khrag 'bab cing gza' phog 'dra/ /shed chung gyur na mchin pa la// srin bus gtses pas sos par dka'// de bcos thabs ni phur rtsi gur| |grang thang blud cing rngul byung na/ /chu grang blud cing bshal yang btab/ /srin sman gtong zhing mgo gzer na/ /ba sha ka dang pi pi ling*// go snyod a ru'i grang thang la// ga pur sbyar ba yang yang blud// gal te mchin pa ma phug na// sos kyang phug nas sos mi srid// sgregs pa mang shing glang 'thab gzer// lus la thor pa thon pa dang*| |rkang pa na zhing lto ba bshal// drod chung grang shum dngangs 'dar byed// rkang lag rkyong zhing kha gdong 'phrig

/mig ni gyen ldog rtse'u chung gzer// dpyi mig na zhing mkhal khung du// gzer la drod chung gyur pa na// lhog pa mkhal mar 'jus pa'i rtags// mkhal ma'i sha zos zhag gsum nas// gar nyams dang bcas pha rol 'gro// gal te sha la ma zos tsam// mgyogs par de dag bcos pa'i thabs// gla rtsi pi ling big pan gsum// phur mong thang gis phul la gtang*// nya phag sha ni mar bcos blud// rme ru rtse dang lang thang rtse// byi tang ka rnams ril bur dril// mar gyis gtums la khong du gtang*/ /mkhan pa 'bru mar mdzo lci dang*// glum dang phabs dang spos kyi shun// khyi phag brun dang sgog skya dang*// bya brun spru ma mkhan pa rnams// mar du bcos pa'i bdug kyang bya/ /skyug long dag la phog pa'i rtags/ /pho bar ri raṃ lang long dang*// kha skom mig ni 'bur tshugs lta// rgyu smad gzer zhing rtsa chu sdom// rkang lag rengs shing nywa rnams 'gyur/ /ba spu gyen log grang 'thor 'byung*// skad mi thon la rngul nag 'bab/ */de bcos thabs ni phur mong dang*// sla nga kha sbyar 'dam pas 'tshang*// du ba ma shor bsregs thal la// srin sman sna tshogs bsres ril bu/ /mar gyis dril la phur mong gi// grang thang blud cing ma gi ta// chang la sbyar ba'ang gtang bar bya// nad 'dis glo ba bzung ba'i rtags// lu ba dka' zhing lu dus gzer// lud pa khrag dang rnag gis gtams// khol bul na zhing gzer ba 'byung*// de yi bcos thabs phur mong dang*// gla gul glo ba'i sman rnams bsre// phur mong gla rtsi'i thang gis phul// tshad pa che na gang chu la// ga pur btab pa kun la sbyar// grang ba shas che bong ba dang*// a ru dzā ti kun la sbyar/ /gal te nyes gsum shas che na/ /rang rang gnyen po sbyar la gtang*| |khrag shas che na khrag dbyung zhes// yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud nas gsungs// gzhan yang rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun/ /don snod gang dang gar bab kyang*//

bshal gyis sbyangs na myur du sos/ /skyug na nad de 'tsho bar dka'/ /nad 'di phog na mi sos pa'i/ /sgos kyi rtags lnga bshad pa ni/ /skad 'gags pa dang ro stod dgye| |'dar zhing skyeg bu 'byung ba dang*/ /sna gnyer ba dang na ma khad// rtsa lam chu lam khrag 'bab na// sngon las smin nam 'phral rkyen gang*/ /yin yang gshin rjes khrid zin pas// sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal pos kyang*// 'tsho ba'i phrin las dus der med// sgos kyi rtags lnga ma tshang na// rtsa chu mi bde zug che zhing*// zungs zad 'chi rtags 'ga' tshang yang*/ /sos pa srid pas sman pa yis/ /sos dang mi sos yid gnyis 'di/ /kha dmar sbrul gyi lce ltar brdab/ /gal te sos pa'i gdeng thob na| |kun la sgrog cing mkhas khyad thon// mi sos pa ru shes pa na// zol gyis gnas gzhan bgrod par byos// 'di lta'i nag po sum sgril gyi// sgos kyi bcos thabs zab mo 'di| |sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa dang*// man ngag rgyud dang bdud rtsi'i bum// shog dril bka' bkol la sogs nas// legs par bsdus shing lag len dang*// myong grub mthong rgyud kyis brgyan te// go sla 'khyer bder bkod pa ni// sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po dang*// sman pa dge 'dun gsang ba'i bu'i// rig gnas ji snyed 'doms mdzad pa// kong sman dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi// drin las thob pa'i rig byed de// dge slong chos kyi grags pa yis/ */zla dgon kun dga' tshal gyi dbus/ */rnam gnon tshul khrims yang thog tu// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams// ma rig gnyid dang zug rngu las// grol te sangs rgyas sa thob shog/ //sarba thā kalyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu//
